courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn how the law is necessary for daily life
(2) Learn about contracts, product liability, and intellectual property rights
(3) Learn how to write a paper about the current legal affairs
(4) Learn how to discuss current legal affairs
advice:
Students will learn current legal affairs as a subject.

The lectures will proceed in the following order:
1. Lecture/discussion
2. Quiz or essay
3. Content of next class
4. Review of the quiz or essay

Students are expected to read the newspaper and show interest in related problems.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students will learn current legal affairs as a subject.

The lectures will proceed in the following order:
1. Lecture/discussion
2. Quiz or essay
3. Content of next class
4. Review of the quiz or essay

Students are expected to read the newspaper and show interest in related problems.
